gateDefinition.entryRule: M1-B Deployable Sandbox work is authorized. Completion requires REQ-CREDIT-009, REQ-UX-004, and REQ-UX-005 to reach VERIFIED_SANDBOX through reproducible authenticated, persistence, restart, replay, negative-authorization, deployment, and browser Evidence bound to one exact deployed commit.
gateDefinition.levelRule: Code presence, UI presence, filenames, comments, mock handlers, static fixtures, and test counts cannot raise a requirement level without the exact runtime Evidence required by this profile.
gateDefinition.releaseBoundary: This profile authorizes one invitation-only no-funds sandbox deployment and bounded closure of the three named blockers. It does not authorize an RC branch, RC commit, release tag, paid pilot, mainnet, production financial claim, fee runtime implementation, signer, transaction, transfer, withdrawal, venue write, new chain, new credit model, broad refactor, visual redesign, or marketing work.
